Tables.TableExpression:
VAR FirstDayOfWeek = 1 -- Use: 0 - Sunday, 1 - Monday, 2 - Tuesday, ... 5 - Friday, 6 - Saturday
VAR FirstSundayReference = DATE ( 1900, 12, 30 ) -- Do not change this 
VAR FirstWeekReference = FirstSundayReference + FirstDayOfWeek
VAR WeekDayCalculationType =
    IF ( FirstDayOfWeek = 0, 7, FirstDayOfWeek ) + 10
RETURN GENERATE (
    SELECTCOLUMNS ( CALENDARAUTO(), "Data", [Date] ),
    VAR CalDate = [Data]
    VAR YearWeekNumber =
        INT ( DIVIDE ( CalDate - FirstWeekReference, 7 ) )
    RETURN ROW (
        "Anno", YEAR ( CalDate ),
        "Mese Anno", FORMAT ( CalDate, "mmm yy" ),
        "MeseAnno", YEAR ( CalDate ) * 12 + MONTH ( CalDate ),
        "SettimanaAnno", YearWeekNumber,
        "Settimana", "W " & FORMAT ( WEEKNUM ( CalDate, WeekDayCalculationType ), "00" ) & FORMAT ( CalDate, "-yy" ),
        "Giorno", FORMAT ( CalDate, "ddd" ),
        "GiornoSettimana", WEEKDAY ( CalDate, WeekDayCalculationType ),
        "Mese", FORMAT ( CalDate, "mmm" ),
        "MeseNumero", MONTH ( CalDate )
    )
)

Measures.MeasureExpression:
IF (
    NOT ISFILTERED ( 'Età' ) && NOT ISFILTERED ( Categoria ) && NOT ISFILTERED ( Genere ),
    VAR LastVisibleDate = 
        MIN ( 
            MAX ( MAX ( Somministrazioni[Data] ), MAX ( Consegne[Data] ) ),
            MAX ( Data[Data] )
        )
    VAR Result = 
        CALCULATE (
            [# Dosi Consegnate] - [# Dosi Somministrate],
            'Data'[Data] <= LastVisibleDate

    RETURN Result
)
Measures.Description: Numero di dosi disponibili in magazzino da somministrare.

Measures.MeasureExpression: DIVIDE ( [# Dosi Somministrate], [# Dosi Consegnate] )
Measures.Description: Percentuale di dosi somministrate rispetto alle dosi consegnate.

RETURN CALCULATE ( [# Dosi / Giorno Somministrate (7 gg)], 'Data'[Data] = _MaxDateAvailable - 7)

Measures.MeasureExpression:
VAR _MaxDate = CALCULATE ( MAX ( Somministrazioni[Data] ) - 1, REMOVEFILTERS() )
VAR _DateStart = FORMAT ( _MaxDate - 6, "dd/mm" )
VAR _DateEnd = FORMAT ( _MaxDate, "dd/mm" )
VAR _RefDateStart = FORMAT ( _MaxDate - 13, "dd/mm" )
VAR _RefDateEnd = FORMAT ( _MaxDate - 7, "dd/mm" )
RETURN "Somministrazioni medie giornaliere" & UNICHAR(10) & _DateStart & "-" & _DateEnd & " vs. " & _RefDateStart & "-" & _RefDateEnd
Measures.Description: Testo descrittivo del periodo degli ultimi 7 giorni di riferimento per gli indicatori Dosi/g.

Measures.MeasureExpression:
VAR _DaysAverage = 7
VAR _MinDateAvailable = CALCULATE ( MIN ( Somministrazioni[Data] ), REMOVEFILTERS() )
VAR _MaxDateAvailable = CALCULATE ( MAX ( Somministrazioni[Data] ) - 1, REMOVEFILTERS() )
VAR _MaxDate = MAX ( 'Data'[Data] )
VAR Result = 
IF ( 
    _MaxDate <= _MaxDateAvailable && (_MaxDate - _DaysAverage) >= _MinDateAvailable,
    CALCULATE (
        DIVIDE ( [# Dosi Somministrate], _DaysAverage ),
        DATESINPERIOD ( 'Data'[Data], MAX ( 'Data'[Data] ), -_DaysAverage, DAY )
    )
)
RETURN Result
Measures.Description: Media giornaliera di somministrazioni (indipendendemente da dose 1 o 2), basata sui 7 giorni precedenti.

    MIN(
        CALCULATE( MAX( Somministrazioni[Data] ) ),
